description: The signed message lacks a maximum bond amount parameter, allowing service owners to unilaterally increase bond requirements after signature generation.
attack_scenario: Operator signs authorization at 1e18 bond per agent. Service owner terminates the service, increases bond to 100e18, reactivates, and uses the original signature to register at 100x higher locking.
root_cause: The signed message lacks a maximum bond amount parameter, allowing service owners to unilaterally increase bond requirements after signature generation.
fix_description: Include maximum bond amount in the signed message. Enforce this limit during execution.
notes: Operators lock 100x more funds than intended. Funds remain locked until service termination, controlled solely by the owner.
